intro: Claude Code builds software from plain-English instructions. Most business owners never try it because the setup looks technical. It isn't. Five steps, about five minutes, no coding.

free.title: Step 1: Get a Claude plan that includes Claude Code
free.body: Claude Code comes with the paid Claude plans (Pro and Max). Pro is enough to start. Check the current price at claude.com/pricing, sign up or upgrade, and keep the login handy.

free.title: Step 2: Download VS Code (free)
free.body: VS Code is a free code editor from Microsoft. Download it from code.visualstudio.com and install it like any app. You won't need to write code in it; it's just where Claude works.

free.title: Step 3: Install the official Claude Code extension
free.body:
• Open VS Code and click the Extensions icon on the left (the four squares).
  • Search for Claude Code and install the one published by Anthropic. Check the publisher name before you click Install.
  • Click the Claude icon that appears and sign in with your Claude account.

free.title: Step 4: Your first project
free.body:
Make a new empty folder on your computer, for example "my-first-tool". In VS Code: File, then Open Folder, and pick it. Then tell Claude what you want in plain English.

Copy this inBuild me a simple web page my team can open in a browser: [e.g. a quote calculator for my services, with my prices]. Keep it to one file. Explain each step in plain English and ask before you install anything.

Claude asks before it changes files or runs commands. Read what it asks and approve it.

free.title: Step 5: Add skills
free.body:
Skills teach Claude how your business does things, so you don't explain it every time.

Copy this inCreate a skill called "my-business" that explains: what we sell [offer], who we sell to [customer], our prices [prices], and how we talk [tone]. Use it in every tool you build for me.

free.title: What to build first
free.body:
• A price or quote calculator for your website
  • A one-page lead form that emails you
  • A checklist your team ticks off for every new customer
  • A tool that turns your notes into a proposal

Start small and keep a copy of anything important. Claude can make mistakes, so test what it builds before your customers use it.
